parts.name: Fleet Officer Tunic Male
parts.desc: an original science-fiction starship officer's uniform tunic: fitted, dark charcoal with a coloured shoulder yoke, a high collar and small rank bars on the collar (no emblems or insignia from any existing franchise)

parts.name: Fleet Officer Tunic Female
parts.desc: an original science-fiction starship officer's fitted uniform tunic, dark charcoal with a coloured shoulder yoke, a high collar and rank bars (no franchise emblems)

parts.name: Wanderer Robes Male
parts.desc: original sci-fi wandering-mystic robes: layered rough-spun tunic with a crossed wrap, a wide sash belt and loose sleeves

parts.name: Armoured Trooper Male
parts.desc: original sci-fi soldier armour: angular gunmetal and olive plates over a black bodysuit, with shoulder pads and glowing cyan seams (not white, not a copy of any existing design)

parts.name: Spacer Vest Male
parts.desc: a sci-fi freighter pilot's look: an off-white shirt with long sleeves under a dark padded utility vest with pouches

parts.name: Flight Suit Female
parts.desc: an original sci-fi pilot flight suit top in teal with a chest harness, shoulder patches and zipped pockets

parts.name: Uniform Trousers Male
parts.desc: sci-fi uniform trousers, dark charcoal with a coloured stripe down the outer seam

parts.name: Uniform Trousers Female
parts.desc: sci-fi uniform trousers, dark charcoal with a coloured stripe down the outer seam

parts.name: Armoured Greaves Male
parts.desc: original sci-fi armoured trousers with angular gunmetal thigh and shin plates over a black bodysuit, glowing cyan seams

parts.name: Tall Uniform Boots
parts.desc: sleek knee-high black sci-fi uniform boots with a thin metallic trim. The boot shaft pieces are only the leg of the boot, from just below the knee down to the ankle, with no foot on them; the shoe pieces are only the foot part.

parts.name: Magnetic Boots
parts.desc: bulky sci-fi magnetic space boots in gunmetal with glowing cyan soles

parts.name: Pilot Helmet
parts.desc: an original sci-fi starfighter pilot helmet with a tinted visor raised and a small antenna

parts.name: Tactical Visor
parts.desc: a sleek sci-fi wraparound tactical visor with a glowing cyan lens and an ear-piece communicator (no helmet)

parts.name: Armoured Gauntlets
parts.desc: sci-fi armoured gauntlets in gunmetal with glowing cyan lines

parts.name: Wanderer Cloak
parts.desc: a long, rough-spun brown hooded travelling cloak falling from the shoulders (the back of the cloak)

parts.name: Blaster Pistol
parts.desc: an original chunky sci-fi blaster pistol with a ribbed barrel, a scope and glowing cyan power cells, facing the same way as the input

parts.name: Plasma Rifle
parts.desc: an original sci-fi plasma rifle with a long ribbed barrel, a glowing energy chamber and a folding stock, facing the same way as the input

parts.name: Energy Sword
parts.desc: an original sci-fi energy sword: a ribbed metal hilt with a long glowing light-blue blade of pure light, pointing the same way as the input

parts.name: Mystic Staff
parts.desc: a tall sci-fi mystic's staff of dark carved wood with a glowing crystal at the top, held vertically
